definitions.explanation: The physical body or its flesh.
The edible part of fish or fruit.

notes:
{身|み} has multiple meanings related to body and self.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {身|み}に{付|つ}ける (to wear; to acquire skill)
- {身|み}に{覚|おぼ}えがある (to have experience of)
- {身|み}を{守|まも}る (to protect oneself)
- {身|み}を{引|ひ}く (to step aside, withdraw)
- {身|み}の{程|ほど} (one's station in life)
- {身|み}の{回|まわ}り (one's surroundings/belongings)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {身体|しんたい}/{身体|からだ}: body
- {身分|みぶん}: social status
- {身元|みもと}: identity
